edits.why_not_lower_lever: The reviewer explicitly rejected the control-flow injection as task-specialized leakage and undeclared bundling. Removing it is the only way to satisfy the objection without introducing new unapproved mechanisms.

(transfer) The harness is now domain-agnostic in its control flow, passing the litmus test for unfamiliar tasks.
